text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Thursday.
- The Jerusalem Post announces the establishment of diplomatic relations between Croatia and Israel which is to come about soon.
- Defence minister Susak: Croatian army to be structured and armed in the western manner by 2005.
- What is behind the annoucement of the stepping down of the president of the Zagreb county and city assembly, Zdravko Tomac?
- In the wake of the crash of the Trieste Credit Bank: Are Croatian banks to lose 100 million German marks?
- It is time for concrete measures to be taken, says in an interview the president of the Croatian Association of Displaced People, Mato Simic.
- Croatia is losing its battle aimed at joining European integrations, claimed at a press conference the Croatian Social Liberal (HSLS) party leader, Vlado Gotovac.
- Croatian Defence Council (HVO) and Croatian Army (HV) general Tihomir Blaskic indicted for war crimes by the Hague tribunal to have his current attorney Zvonimir Hodak replaced by Anto Nobilo.
- A crook is a crook, there are no big-time and minor thieves, says in an interview Milan Kovac the president of the Croatian Privatisation Fund. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
